thread:
Carla: Heads up — Titan Systems raised a hard blocker in today's exec call: they require all PII and model logs to remain EU-only for the entire POC. Asking for private/on-prem options and a quote for price delta. Can we escalate? cc @Sam @Neil @Jess :eyes:
Sam: Noted. Do they mean full on-prem (air-gapped) or a customer VPC with a private control plane hosted in eu-central-1 + customer-managed KMS?
Carla: They used the phrase "no cross-border storage" and explicitly asked for HSM-backed keys and SAML SSO. They want a 6-month POC on dedicated capacity.
Neil: We can do Redwood Private in-customer VPC or an on-prem package. For hosted/dedicated the model weights would still be in our infra — seems that won't fly. Need expected throughput to size.
Carla: Their preliminary numbers: ~80 RPS, ~30M tokens/day during peak. Also they want model artifacts to never leave their network.
Olivia: Engineering note — for a fully on-prem install with that profile we're looking at roughly 4x A100 (80GB) + HA infra for headroom. Install and validation effort ~6 weeks + 1 week for compliance checks.
Jess: From security: we need to confirm which certifications they require in-scope (SOC2, ISO27001) and whether they will insist on contract-level data locality clauses and subprocessor restrictions. We support external KMS/HSM integration, but it needs engineering time to validate.
Marco: Legal can prep a DPA addendum and NDA quickly if they share their template. Question from our side: are we willing to discount the POC? If discounted, what are the commercial guardrails (term, referenceability, success metrics)?
Carla: Finance is asking for signoff if we offer a 40% POC discount + waived onboarding. Sales wants exec approval before promising that.
Sam: 40% on an on-prem private POC is steep. Suggest offer: 20% discount + waive PS if they commit to a paid deployment within 12 months and provide a case study/reference. That's more defendable.
Olivia: Cost estimate (rough): infra + cloud footprint for equivalent infra ~€30k/month. Professional services for deployment & validation ~€40k one-time. These are ballpark numbers; will tighten after sizing pass.
Carla: @Anika can CS assign a TAM and are we able to guarantee a 4-week support SLA during POC if needed?
Anika: We can assign a TAM, but a 4-week guaranteed SLA requires a Dedicated Support add-on and exec approval. We can trial higher-touch support without the SLA if exec approval takes time.
DeployBot: POC workspace created: titan-systems-poc-1947001234 — private_deploy_flag: OFF (manual action required to provision onprem).
Carla: Ask: can someone escalate to Priya/Pipeline Exec to approve 20% discount + PS waiver contingent on the case-study clause? Pitch: strategic reference in financial sector, EU-only footprint, multi-year ARR potential.
Neil: Looping in Priya now. Priya, quick summary: Titan Systems wants on-prem/private 6-month POC, 4x A100 sizing, EU-only data, HSM + SAML, asking for 20-40% discount. Need exec signoff on commercial and SLA.
Priya: Thanks Neil — putting on my calendar. Please drop a one-page business case with expected ARR, margin impact, and timeline by EOD and I'll escalate to CRO.
Carla: Will do. I'll post the one-pager (numbers + PS estimate + proposed commercial terms) in this thread before EOD. Appreciate quick responses. :thumbsup:
